[[File:Alpha-class_Star_Wing_XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|M-s3 launchers were used on [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing]] fighters]]
The '''M-s3 concussion missile launcher''' was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use in the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bomber]] and the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing]], which also mounted a [[T-s5 proton torpedo launcher/Legends|T-s5 proton torpedo launcher]] in its ordnance pod. The [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] also had homing capabilities.
